parameters.query:
SELECT
  l.id                AS lead_id,
  l.email,
  l.email_domain,
  l.first_name,
  l.last_name,
  l.full_name,
  l.company,
  l.title,
  l.icp_score,
  l.icp_tier,
  l.score_breakdown,
  l.source,
  l.status            AS lead_status,
  lb.brief            AS brief,
  c.industry,
  c.sub_industry,
  c.employee_count,
  c.annual_revenue,
  c.country,
  c.city,
  c.tech_stack,
  c.funding_raised,
  cc.icp_config,
  cc.sender_name,
  cc.sender_title,
  cc.company_name     AS client_company,
  cc.value_proposition,
  cc.tone,
  cc.email_constraints
FROM leads l
LEFT JOIN lead_briefs   lb ON lb.lead_id   = l.id
LEFT JOIN companies      c  ON c.id         = l.company_id
LEFT JOIN client_configs cc ON cc.client_id = (
  SELECT client_id FROM workers WHERE worker_type = 'agent-x' LIMIT 1
)
WHERE l.id = $1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  se.subject,
  se.body_text,
  se.open_rate,
  se.reply_rate,
  se.tier
FROM sequence_steps se
JOIN sequences s ON s.id = se.sequence_id
WHERE se.step_number = 1
  AND se.reply_rate   > 0.05
  AND se.open_rate    > 0.35
  AND s.status        = 'active'
  AND se.tier         = $1
ORDER BY se.reply_rate DESC
LIMIT 3;

values.content: You are a B2B sales strategist. Analyse the lead profile and choose the single most effective messaging angle for a cold email. Output ONLY valid JSON — no markdown, no preamble.

parameters.query:
WITH new_seq AS (
  INSERT INTO sequences (
    lead_id, status, tier, created_at
  ) VALUES (
    $1, 'active', $2, NOW()
  )
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO sequence_steps (
  sequence_id, step_number, step_type,
  subject, body_text, preview_text,
  scheduled_at, status,
  confidence, word_count,
  personalisation_used,
  subject_variant,
  subject_a, subject_b,
  strategy_used,
  created_at
) VALUES (
  (SELECT id FROM new_seq),
  1, 'email',
  $3, $4, $5,
  NOW() + INTERVAL '5 minutes',
  'scheduled',
  $6, $7,
  $8::jsonb,
  $9, $10, $11, $12,
  NOW()
)
RETURNING id AS step_id, sequence_id;

INSERT INTO activities (type, lead_id, payload, created_at)
VALUES ('email_generated', $1, $2::jsonb, NOW());
